decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper builds directly on the firm's core construction vehicle know-how, so it can absorb market feedback and refine the product through its own R&D.
The articulated dumper extends the firm's established vehicle engineering and service base, giving it the related knowledge to learn from results and adapt the product to customers.
The multi-model telescopic loader line rests on the firm's lifting and vehicle expertise and gives broad feedback the firm can readily assimilate for continuous improvement.
The material lift is close to the firm's established offer and shows strong rental demand, including a large order, so the firm can easily interpret and exploit the results.

Although the mining loader is distant from the core offer, its documented 1,000 operating hours in seven months give clear field data, and the firm's underground vehicle engineering and R&D let it learn from and improve the machine, unlike the withdrawn rescue vehicle.
